lines.t:
The ability to successfully <c:ffff00>evade<c>: dodging quickly
just before an {{opponent}}'s <c:ffff00>attack<c> lands, trying to
avoid taking <c:ffff00>{{damage}}<c>.

It is mostly determined by the <c:ffff00>{{mobility}}<c> stat of the
<c:ffff00>legs<c>; the <c:ffff00>{{fighting}}<c>/<c:ffff00>{{shooting}}<c> stat and <c:ffff00>{{medal_level}}<c>
also have an effect.
